title: Famous archaeological sites and the ancient culture that built them

source.name: Wikidata (CC0)
source.method: sparql:SELECT ?item ?itemLabel ?article ?sitelinks ?cultureLabel WHERE { { SELECT ?item (SAMPLE(?c) AS ?culture) (COUNT(DISTINCT ?c) AS ?n) WHERE { ?item wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q839954 ; wdt:P2596 ?c ; wikibase:sitelinks ?sl . FILTER(?sl >= 20) } GROUP BY ?item } hint:Prior hint:runFirst true . culture.match: Match each site to the culture that built it.
culture.odd: Three of these sites were built by {value}. Which one wasn't?
culture.reverse: Which of these sites was built by {value}?

rows.label: Colosseum
rows.description: ancient Roman amphitheatre, a landmark of Rome, Italy
rows.hook: hosted gladiator fights and other bloody public spectacles before huge crowds

rows.label: Machu Picchu
rows.description: 15th-century Inca citadel in the Peruvian Andes and UNESCO World Heritage Site
rows.hook: is a mountaintop citadel nicknamed the lost city in the clouds

rows.label: Pompeii
rows.description: ancient Roman city near modern Naples, Italy
rows.hook: was buried under volcanic ash when Mount Vesuvius erupted

rows.label: Petra
rows.description: ancient rock-cut historical city in Jordan
rows.hook: is a city carved into rose-red cliffs and reached through a narrow canyon called the Siq

rows.label: Terracotta Army
rows.description: collection of ancient Chinese military statues
rows.hook: is a vast buried force of thousands of life-size clay soldiers guarding an emperor's tomb

rows.label: Hadrian's Wall
rows.description: defensive fortification in Roman Britain
rows.hook: is a long stone barrier that marked the northern frontier of an empire in Britain

rows.label: Acropolis of Athens
rows.description: ancient citadel above the city of Athens
rows.hook: is a rocky hilltop citadel crowned by the Parthenon

rows.label: Chichen Itza
rows.description: pre-Columbian Maya city in Mexico
rows.hook: has a stepped pyramid where shadows form a slithering serpent at the equinox

rows.label: Ephesus
rows.description: ancient Greek city in Anatolia
rows.hook: is a port city known for its grand library facade and huge theatre

rows.label: Temple of Ephesian Artemis
rows.description: temple in Ephesus, one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World
rows.hook: was a colossal marble shrine counted among the original Seven Wonders of the world

rows.label: Cahokia
rows.description: archaeological site near East St. Louis, Illinois, USA

rows.label: Delphi
rows.description: ancient town in Fokida, Greece
rows.hook: housed a famous oracle who gave cryptic prophecies to visitors seeking guidance

rows.label: Knossos
rows.description: ancient Minoan through Roman administrative center and city
rows.hook: is the palace linked to the legend of the labyrinth and the Minotaur

rows.label: Valley of the Kings
rows.description: necropolis in ancient Egypt
rows.hook: is a desert gorge of burial tombs where Tutankhamun's resting place was discovered

rows.label: Circus Maximus
rows.description: Ancient Roman circus in Rome
rows.hook: was a huge chariot-racing stadium that held hundreds of thousands of spectators

rows.label: Roman Forum
rows.description: Ancient Roman center of the city, a landmark of Rome, Italy
rows.hook: was the bustling heart of public life, lined with temples and government halls

rows.label: Abu Simbel
rows.description: UNESCO World Heritage Site in southern Egypt
rows.hook: has giant rock-cut statues of a pharaoh that were moved to save them from a rising lake

rows.label: Tikal
rows.description: ruins of major ancient Maya city
rows.hook: is a jungle city whose towering temple-pyramids rise above the rainforest canopy

rows.label: Karnak Temple Complex
rows.description: ancient Egyptian temple complex
rows.hook: is a sprawling religious site famous for its forest of giant carved stone columns

rows.label: Olympia
rows.description: town on the Peloponnese peninsula in Greece, site of the ancient Olympic Games
rows.hook: was the sanctuary where athletes competed in the original Olympic games

rows.label: Harappa
rows.description: archaeological site in Punjab, Pakistan

rows.label: Panathenaic Stadium
rows.description: stadium in Athens, Greece
rows.hook: is an all-marble arena that hosted the first modern Olympics
